scans.symptoms: Concentric dark-brown target-board rings on lower mature leaves, surrounded by yellow chlorotic halos.

remedies.title: Remove Lower Infected Foliage
remedies.instructions: Clip off infected lower leaves using sanitized pruning shears. Never throw infected leaves in compost heap.

remedies.title: Trichoderma viride & Neem Oil Spray
remedies.instructions: Apply cold pressed neem oil (3000 ppm) with mild soap emulsifier or spray Trichoderma viride culture.

remedies.title: Mancozeb or Chlorothalonil
remedies.instructions: Foliar spray of Mancozeb 75% WP or Azoxystrobin 23% SC on clear, dry mornings.

scans.symptoms: Concentric dark brown target-board rings on lower mature foliage with chlorotic yellow halo.

remedies.title: Prune Lower Foliage
remedies.instructions: Carefully prune infected bottom 2-3 leaf branches. Sterilize shears with 70% alcohol and burn or bury infected residue away from compost.

remedies.title: Neem & Trichoderma Spray
remedies.instructions: Spray Trichoderma viride (10g/L) or cold-pressed Neem Oil (5ml/L) emulsified with mild soap every 7 days.

remedies.title: Fungicidal Protection
remedies.instructions: Apply Mancozeb 75% WP or Copper Oxychloride 50% WP during a dry morning window.

scans.symptoms: Interveinal chlorosis on older mature leaves; leaf veins remain green while leaf lamina turns yellow.

remedies.title: Magnesium Sulfate Foliar Spray
remedies.instructions: Dissolve Agricultural grade Epsom Salt (Magnesium Sulphate MgSO4) in water and spray on foliage early morning.

remedies.title: Dolomite Lime Soil Incorporation
remedies.instructions: Broadcast powdered dolomite lime around root zones to balance soil pH and supply slow-release magnesium and calcium.

scans.symptoms: Marginal browning and leaf tip scorch on older leaves; curling of leaf margins downwards.

remedies.title: Hardwood Ash or Bio-Potash
remedies.instructions: Apply hardwood wood ash or potash mobilizing bacteria (KMB) near the root zone.

remedies.title: Sulphate of Potash (SOP 0:0:50)
remedies.instructions: Apply 00:00:50 foliar spray to rapidly restore potassium reserves without adding unwanted chloride.
